exceptions.reason: Core surface is 19 tools by design; ~80 more stay behind search_tools. Size is held by tests/test_schema_budget.py.
Browser actions cannot be de-duplicated by the server: a page cannot tell a retried click from a new one, so an idempotency key would promise what it cannot deliver.
Page JavaScript cannot be sandboxed read-only; the dedicated read tools (get_text_content, get_interaction_tree, screenshot) are the read-only path.
